productName: French Country Full Guard Rail Kit
description:
French Country Full Guard Rail Kit is the full-length guard rail made for the French Country cribs (Slat Style Front and Panel Style Front), for use once the crib is converted to a toddler or full-size bed. It is not a separate standalone bed.

It runs the entire length of the bed along the open side. Solid hardwood, finished to match your crib, with attachment hardware included. Remove it when it is no longer needed.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
